post_review_hardening.source: user-run Codex working-tree review (the aggregate pass the in-session gate could not run)

findings_fixed.summary: rollback regressed state before validating the winner — a crafted better-metadata commit that fails MLS/admin validation could force epoch regression and discard the valid branch. Fixed: validate winner against a throwaway deserialized snapshot before any mutation; only roll back on success.

past-epoch-only ingest batch advanced this.state (Step 1b) but exited via the read.length===0 early return before save(), leaving persisted state stale. Fixed: save() before the early return when Step 1b processed anything.

Step 1b past-epoch app path bypassed the #sentEventIds self-echo guard; a senders own echo decrypted via a retained past key could be re-processed (desired-gen-in-the-past / duplicate history). Fixed: self-echo guard added to Step 1b.
Prettier formatting failures on changed source + spec files. Fixed: formatted.

post_review_hardening.test_gap_closed: Added a genuine cross-batch rollback test (winner arrives in a later batch, decrypted only via the retained past-epoch key) proving S2+S4 resolve the real delayed-delivery fork.

findings_fixed.summary: Rollback persisted the rolled-back state before the winner was re-applied (premature #rollbackToEpoch save + later set/processMessage could fail), leaving durable regression. Fixed: rollback is now single-process and transactional — the winner is applied once against a deserialized snapshot with a state-bound callback, and this.state is mutated only on success; the final ingest save() persists it. #rollbackToEpoch removed.

A better candidate that failed validation was permanently skipped as lost-race; missing proposal refs / temporarily-unverifiable state could become valid later. Fixed: on validation throw the winner is queued to unreadable for retry, preserving eventual convergence.

Admin verification used a callback captured once before the loop, carrying a stale ratchet tree across rollback and multi-commit batches. Fixed: callback now built from the exact state each commit is processed against (createAdminVerificationCallbackForState).
Locally-sent app messages were not tracked in #messagesByEpoch, so a rollback omitted them from invalidatedMessages. Fixed: sendApplicationRumor records the sent event under its epoch.

selfUpdate()/commit() did not pass #mlsClientConfig to createCommit, so inner-layer past-epoch retention (default 4) lagged the outer window (pastEpochDepth=5). Fixed: clientConfig threaded into both createCommit calls.

Replay guard hashed the outer Nostr event.content, which createGroupEvent NIP-44-wraps with a fresh nonce per wrap — so a re-wrapped duplicate of an applied commit bypassed the guard and could trigger a spurious rollback. Fixed: hash the deterministic serialized MLS message via new exported mlsCommitContentHash; isReplayOfApplied now compares precomputed hashes.

A winning commit referencing an external proposal not in the snapshot stayed stuck unreadable (the late proposal was processed against current state, never the snapshot), breaking convergence for proposal-reference commits. Fixed: past-epoch proposals are merged into the matching epoch snapshot so a pending rollback can resolve the reference.

pastEpochDepth was exposed on MarmotGroupOptions but not forwarded through MarmotClient.groupOptions or GroupsManagerOptions, so main-client consumers could not configure the window. Fixed: threaded through both.
pnpm-lock.yaml and epic-state.json failed prettier --check, so pnpm lint failed on a clean checkout. Fixed: pnpm-lock.yaml added to .prettierignore (generated artifact); epic-state.json formatted.

tests_added: replay guard recognises a re-wrapped duplicate commit
past-epoch proposal merges into the matching snapshot
